visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stark black background featuring centered white handwritten text. (2) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail, wearing a blue and white striped button-up shirt and white shorts, stands before a white brick wall. She holds a pink folding mirror, touching her cheek with a concerned facial expression while examining her complexion. The scene briefly transitions to a grayscale filter with large text overlays. (3) The woman sits at a white desk in an indoor room, typing on a black laptop. A white mug sits beside her. She stops typing to yawn deeply, covering her mouth with her hand, appearing physically exhausted. (4) Seated on a light-colored sofa, the woman holds an open book titled '想要的孩子'. She moves the book closer and further from her face, squinting her eyes in frustration and rubbing her right eye with her finger. (5) Standing in a kitchen-like area with a refrigerator covered in magnets, the woman eats a biscuit from a square gold tin. Her expression suddenly shifts from enjoyment to shock as she looks down and grasps her stomach area with both hands. (6) In a brighter setting with the same white brick background, the woman appears in a different outfit consisting of a white lace-trimmed top and a beige vest. She holds a brown glass bottle with a white and red label, waving cheerfully at the camera with a wide smile. (7) A white background displays a product box and bottle alongside a detailed list of seven ingredients written in black and red text. (8) Close-up shot of the woman holding a small black oval capsule between her thumb and forefinger. She places the capsule in her mouth, follows it with a drink from a unicorn-patterned mug, and gives a satisfied smile and nod to the camera. (9) A close-up of a white countertop shows the product bottle standing alone. A hand enters the frame from the left side and quickly sweeps the bottle away as the final logo appears.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a brief silence followed by a high-pitched, energetic female voice posing a question. Gentle, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano music play in the background. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the speaker's voice becomes more somber, describing skin problems with a low pitch level and falling intonation. The BGM remains soft. (3) Distinct mechanical clicking sounds of a keyboard are heard. The female voice speaks with a tired, drawn-out prosody, sighing audibly. Another 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the end of the segment. (4) The rustling sound of paper pages turning accompanies the voice, which sounds strained and confused. Pitch variability increases as the speaker describes blurry vision. (5) A sharp 'crunch' sound effect occurs as the speaker reacts to eating. Her voice quickly shifts to a high-arousal, panicked tone with rapid speech rate. (6) A bright chime sounds, and the BGM swells in volume and brightness. The female voice becomes highly enthusiastic and professional, pitching a product with rising intonation and clear articulation. (7) The speaker methodically lists ingredients with a steady, authoritative rhythm. The upbeat pop BGM maintains a consistent 120 BPM tempo. (8) Sound of a liquid swallow followed by a cheerful 'Bye Bye' from the speaker. The audio concludes with a final bright stinger and a digital 'ding' effect.
